fact_record_fields.name: fact_id
fact_record_fields.description: Stable identifier for the fact within one task.

fact_record_fields.name: statement
fact_record_fields.description: Atomic, source-grounded claim written as a single verifiable sentence.

fact_record_fields.name: evidence_keys
fact_record_fields.description: One or more keys from evidence_key_registry.json supporting the claim.

fact_record_fields.name: source_asset_ids
fact_record_fields.description: Archive asset identifiers or tool outputs needed to verify the fact.

fact_record_fields.name: severity_relevance
fact_record_fields.description: Optional note describing whether the fact supports severity, uncertainty, or follow-up action.

guidelines: Each fact should be independently checkable from archived assets or tool traces.
Do not combine multiple claims into one fact.
Prefer observable evidence over inferred narrative language.
Use evidence keys rather than free-form source descriptions wherever possible.

example_fact.statement: Flooded road segments are visible within the target region.
